questions.text: The North Platte River _____ from Wyoming into Nebraska.
questions.explanation: Subject sudah ada, kurang satu verb sejati: 'flows'. 'it flowed' menambah subject; 'flowing' tanpa be hanya penerang; 'with flowing water' tidak ada verb.
hints: Kalimat ini butuh apa: subject, verb, atau keduanya?
Subject sudah ada. Pilih bagian yang membawa tense, tanpa menambah subject.
B 'flows'. 'it flowed' membuat dua subject; 'flowing' bukan verb tanpa be.

xray.marked: S{The North Platte River} V{flows} P{from Wyoming} P{into Nebraska}.

questions.text: _____ Biloxi received its name from a Sioux word meaning "first people."
questions.explanation: Verb 'received' sudah ada, yang kurang subject. 'The city of Biloxi' jadi subject. Pilihan lain tidak memberi subject yang benar atau menambah verb.
hints: Kalimat butuh apa? Lihat dulu bagian setelah titik kosong.
'received' sudah verb sejati. Yang kosong harus berisi kata benda sebagai subject.
A. 'The city of Biloxi' = subject. 'It is in' dan 'The tour included' menambah verb.

xray.marked: S{The city of Biloxi} V{received} its name P{from a Sioux word} M{meaning "first people."}

questions.text: A pride of lions _____ up to forty lions, including one to three males, several females, and cubs.
questions.explanation: Subject 'a pride' (singular) butuh verb sejati: 'can contain'. 'it contains' menambah subject, 'contain' tidak cocok dengan 'pride', 'containing' hanya penerang.
hints: Subject-nya apa? Ingat 'of lions' itu frasa depan.
Subject 'a pride' singular. Cari verb sejati yang tidak menambah subject.
A 'can contain'. 'contain' tidak cocok (pride singular), 'containing' bukan verb tanpa be.

xray.marked: S{A pride} P{of lions} V{can contain} up to forty lions, M{including one to three males, several females, and cubs}.

questions.text: _____ tea plant are small and white.
questions.explanation: Verb 'are' sudah ada, yang kurang subject: 'The flowers of the tea plant'. 'On the' membuat frasa depan tanpa subject.
hints: Kalimat butuh apa?
'are' sudah ada. Yang kosong harus membentuk subject plural yang utuh bersama 'tea plant'.
D. 'The flowers' subject plural cocok dengan 'are'; 'of the tea plant' frasa depan.

xray.marked: S{The flowers} P{of the tea plant} V{are} small and white.

questions.text: The tetracyclines, _____ antibiotics, are used to treat infections.
questions.explanation: 'The tetracyclines' sudah punya verb 'are used'. Di antara dua koma masuk appositive (tanpa verb): 'a family of antibiotics'. 'being a family' tidak punya 'of' sebelum 'antibiotics'.
hints: Perhatikan dua koma. Apa fungsi bagian di antaranya?
Verb sejati sudah ada ('are used'). Isi koma-koma itu sebaiknya tanpa verb.
C. Appositive 'a family of antibiotics' menerangkan 'tetracyclines'. A dan D menambah verb.

xray.marked: S{The tetracyclines}, M{a family of antibiotics}, V{are used} M{to treat infections}.

questions.text: Any possible academic assistance from taking stimulants _____ marginal at best.
questions.explanation: Subject 'any possible academic assistance' sudah lengkap, kurang verb: 'is'. 'it is' menambah subject, 'there is' memunculkan subject baru, 'as' tidak punya verb.
hints: Coret 'from taking stimulants'. Apa yang tersisa?
Subject ada, verb belum. Pilih yang hanya menambah verb.
C 'is'. 'it is' dan 'there is' menambah subject kedua.

xray.marked: S{Any possible academic assistance} P{from taking stimulants} V{is} marginal P{at best}.

questions.text: Henry Adams, born in Boston, _____ famous as a historian and novelist.
questions.explanation: 'born in Boston' penerang di antara koma. Kurang satu verb sejati: 'became'. Pilihan lain menambah connector atau subject yang tidak perlu.
hints: 'born in Boston' di antara koma itu verb atau penerang?
Penerang sudah ada, tinggal satu verb sejati tanpa tambahan subject.
A 'became'. 'he was' dan 'and he became' menambah subject kedua.

xray.marked: S{Henry Adams}, M{born in Boston}, V{became} famous P{as a historian and novelist}.

questions.text: The major cause _____ the pull of the Moon on the Earth.

options.text: of the tides in the ocean

questions.explanation: Subject 'the major cause', butuh frasa 'of ocean tides' lalu verb 'is'. A menambah subject lain, C dan D tidak punya verb.
hints: Subject 'the major cause' butuh apa supaya kalimat lengkap?
Subject butuh verb sejati, dan 'of ...' adalah frasa depan.
B. 'of ocean tides' frasa depan, 'is' verb. A menambah subject baru.

xray.marked: S{The major cause} P{of ocean tides} V{is} the pull P{of the Moon} P{on the Earth}.

questions.text: Still a novelty in the late nineteenth century, _____ limited to the rich.
questions.explanation: Frasa pembuka 'Still a novelty ...' penerang. Kalimat butuh subject lalu verb, dengan urutan subject dulu: 'photography was'.
hints: Bagian sebelum koma itu subject atau penerang?
Kalimat butuh subject DAN verb, dengan subject lebih dulu.
D 'photography was'. B dan C menaruh verb sebelum subject atau menambah subject.

xray.marked: M{Still a novelty in the late nineteenth century}, S{photography} V{was limited} P{to the rich}.

questions.text: A computerized map of the freeways using information gathered by sensors embedded in the pavement _____ on a local cable channel during rush hours.
questions.explanation: 'using ...', 'gathered ...', 'embedded ...' semuanya penerang. Subject 'a computerized map' butuh verb sejati: 'airs'. 'air' tidak cocok dengan subject singular.
hints: Banyak sekali -ing dan -ed di kalimat ini. Mana yang membawa tense?
Semua -ing/-ed tanpa be itu penerang. Subject 'a computerized map' belum punya verb.
A 'airs'. 'airing' dan 'to air' bukan verb sejati; 'air' tidak cocok dengan subject singular.

xray.marked: S{A computerized map} P{of the freeways} M{using information gathered by sensors embedded in the pavement} V{airs} P{on a local cable channel} P{during rush hours}.
